scheme_name: Incentive for the Intra Caste Marriage within Scheduled Caste Community
other_conditions: Couple must belong to different sub‑castes of SC or ST
Both bride and groom must reside in Karnataka
Family income must not exceed ₹2,00,000 per annum
Bride age between 18 and 42 years at the time of marriage
Groom age between 21 and 45 years at the time of marriage
Application must be submitted within one year of marriage
benefits_summary: Cash incentive of up to ₹2,00,000 (or ₹1,50,000 if the simple marriage grant is availed), paid in two installments (50% cash, 50% fixed deposit).
